conversions.title: HEIC to JPG Converter – Free & Private | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert HEIC photos to widely compatible JPG files in your browser. Free batch conversion with adjustable quality and no server uploads.
conversions.intro: Turn iPhone and iPad HEIC photos into JPG files that are easier to open, share, and upload. Conversion happens locally in your browser, and you can change the output format at any time.
conversions.fromBody: HEIC is a container commonly used by Apple devices for HEIF images. It can preserve good visual quality at a smaller size than an equivalent JPEG, but older apps, websites, and non-Apple workflows do not always accept it.
conversions.toBody: JPG is a lossy image format supported by nearly every browser, editor, messaging app, and upload form. It is best suited to photographs and other images with many colors or gradual tones.
when: A website or form rejects an HEIC upload.
You need to send photos to someone using software without HEIC support.
A printing, editing, or document workflow expects JPG files.
conversions.note: JPG does not support transparency. HEIC metadata is not copied into the converted file, and re-encoding may introduce a small quality loss.
comparison: Good on recent Apple systems; mixed elsewhere
May be present in the container
faqs: Will my HEIC photo be uploaded?
No. The HEIC decoder and JPG encoder run in a Web Worker on your device.
Can I convert several HEIC photos at once?
Yes. Add up to 20 files, convert them sequentially, then download individual JPG files or a ZIP.
Does conversion preserve EXIF metadata?
No. The current converter writes the decoded pixels to a new file and does not copy source metadata.
Why can JPG look slightly different?
JPG uses lossy compression. Choose a higher quality setting when preserving fine photographic detail matters.

conversions.title: HEIC to PNG Converter – Free & Private | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert HEIC images to lossless PNG files locally in your browser. No uploads, no account, and batch conversion is supported.
conversions.intro: Convert HEIC images to PNG when you need a lossless output that works in browsers, design tools, and document workflows. Your files stay on your device throughout the conversion.
conversions.fromBody: HEIC is an efficient image container often produced by Apple cameras. It saves storage space well, though support can be inconsistent outside newer Apple software and modern imaging tools.
conversions.toBody: PNG stores images with lossless compression and supports an alpha channel for transparency. It is dependable for screenshots, graphics, interface assets, and images that will be edited repeatedly.
when: You want lossless output for further editing.
Your destination supports PNG but cannot decode HEIC.
You need a web-friendly format that can represent transparency.
conversions.note: PNG files are often much larger than HEIC photos. Converting to PNG preserves decoded pixels without another lossy step, but it cannot recover detail already absent from the source.
faqs: Is HEIC to PNG lossless?
The PNG encoding is lossless, but the decoded HEIC source may itself have been encoded with loss.
Why is the PNG larger?
PNG prioritizes exact pixel storage rather than the photographic compression efficiency of HEIC.
Are HEIC files sent to a server?
No. Decoding and encoding take place locally in your browser.
Can I download a ZIP?
Yes. After converting two or more images, the converter offers one ZIP download.

conversions.title: PNG to JPG Converter – Free Batch Tool | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert PNG images to compact JPG files in your browser. Adjust quality, convert batches, and keep your images on your device.
conversions.intro: Change PNG images into smaller, widely accepted JPG files for photo sharing, uploads, and documents. Select the quality you need before converting.
conversions.fromBody: PNG is a lossless format that keeps sharp edges and can include transparent pixels. It works especially well for logos, screenshots, diagrams, and interface graphics, but photographic PNGs can be large.
conversions.toBody: JPG compresses photographs efficiently by discarding some visual information. It cannot store transparency, but it is accepted almost everywhere and is usually compact for camera-style images.
when: A photographic PNG is too large for an upload or email.
A service accepts JPG but not PNG.
Transparency is not needed and broad compatibility matters.
conversions.note: Transparent PNG pixels must be flattened because JPG has no alpha channel. This converter places them on a white background; do not use JPG when the transparent background must remain.
faqs: What happens to a transparent background?
Transparent areas are placed on white because JPG cannot store transparency.
Can JPG be smaller than PNG?
Usually yes for photographs. For flat graphics or text, the result depends on the image and quality setting.
Is there a quality control?
Yes. Use the quality slider before conversion; a higher value usually means more detail and a larger file.
Can I process multiple PNG files?
Yes, up to 20 files per batch, with a 50 MB limit for each file.

conversions.title: JPG to PNG Converter – Free & Lossless Output | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert JPG photos to PNG locally in your browser. Create lossless PNG output without uploading files or creating an account.
conversions.intro: Convert JPG files to PNG for workflows that require lossless output, PNG compatibility, or repeated editing. The conversion runs entirely on your device.
conversions.fromBody: JPG is a compact, lossy format designed mainly for photographs. Each JPEG encoding can discard subtle detail, which helps reduce file size but may leave visible artifacts around sharp edges.
conversions.toBody: PNG uses lossless compression, supports transparency, and keeps newly encoded pixels exact. It is commonly used for graphics, screenshots, UI assets, and files that will undergo more editing.
when: An application or workflow specifically requires PNG.
You want to avoid another lossy save during later edits.
You need a dependable browser format for graphics or documentation.
conversions.note: Converting JPG to PNG does not restore detail previously removed by JPEG compression, and it does not invent transparency. The PNG is often larger than the original JPG.
faqs: Will JPG to PNG improve image quality?
No. It prevents a new lossy PNG encoding step, but cannot recover information already discarded by JPG.
Will the output become transparent?
No. The format supports transparency, but ordinary JPG pixels remain opaque after conversion.
Why did the file get larger?
PNG stores pixels losslessly, which is less space-efficient for many photographs.
Where is my image processed?
Inside your browser, using a Web Worker and WebAssembly codecs.

conversions.title: JPG to WebP Converter – Free Online Tool | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert JPG images to modern WebP files in your browser. Tune output quality, process batches, and upload nothing.
conversions.intro: Create WebP versions of JPG images for websites and modern content workflows. Adjust output quality and convert several files without sending them to a server.
conversions.fromBody: JPG remains the default exchange format for photographs because its support is nearly universal. Its older compression design can require larger files than newer formats at a comparable visual quality.
conversions.toBody: WebP is a modern image format developed for the web. It supports lossy and lossless coding as well as transparency, and current major browsers can display it directly.
when: You are preparing photographs for a modern website.
You want to test a smaller alternative to existing JPG assets.
Your target browser, CMS, or application explicitly supports WebP.
conversions.note: File-size savings vary by source and quality setting. Converting an already compressed JPG cannot restore its lost detail, so compare the output visually before replacing originals.
faqs: Will WebP always be smaller?
Not always. Dimensions, source compression, and the selected quality all affect the result.
Can older software open WebP?
Some older desktop tools cannot. Keep a JPG fallback when your audience uses legacy software.
Does this tool resize the image?
No. It preserves the decoded pixel dimensions and changes the image encoding.
Can I convert a folder?
You can select multiple files, but browsers do not expose an entire folder unless the picker supports folder selection.

conversions.title: WebP to JPG Converter – Free & Private | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert WebP images to compatible JPG files locally. Free batch tool with adjustable quality and no image uploads.
conversions.intro: Convert WebP images to JPG for applications, upload forms, and devices that expect the older format. Everything runs locally in your browser.
conversions.fromBody: WebP is designed for efficient web delivery and can store lossy, lossless, or transparent images. Browser support is now broad, but some document tools and older desktop programs still reject it.
conversions.toBody: JPG is a universally recognized lossy photo format. Its lack of transparency and older compression are trade-offs for excellent compatibility across software and services.
when: A desktop application cannot open a downloaded WebP image.
An upload field accepts JPG but rejects WebP.
You need a photo format that recipients can open without special software.
conversions.note: Transparent WebP areas are flattened onto white in JPG. Re-encoding a lossy WebP as JPG may add compression artifacts, so use a high quality setting when possible.
faqs: What happens to WebP transparency?
It is flattened onto a white background because JPG cannot represent transparent pixels.
Does converting improve quality?
No. Conversion changes compatibility, not the detail available in the source.
Can I choose JPG quality?
Yes. Set the quality slider before starting the conversion.
Are animations supported?
No. The current tool converts still images and does not preserve animated WebP frames.

conversions.title: WebP to PNG Converter – Keep Transparency | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert still WebP images to lossless PNG files in your browser. Preserve transparent pixels with private, local processing.
conversions.intro: Turn still WebP files into lossless PNG images for editing, design, and software that does not support WebP. Transparent pixels can remain transparent in the PNG output.
conversions.fromBody: WebP is a compact web image format that supports both transparency and multiple compression modes. It is efficient in browsers, although compatibility can still be uneven in older creative and office software.
conversions.toBody: PNG is a mature lossless format with reliable alpha transparency. It is a common interchange choice for logos, icons, screenshots, and other assets that need crisp edges.
when: A design or office application does not accept WebP.
You need lossless output for another round of editing.
The source has transparency that must be retained.
conversions.note: PNG output can be considerably larger. Animated WebP is not preserved; the current converter is intended for still images only.
faqs: Will transparency be preserved?
Yes, when the decoded WebP contains an alpha channel, PNG can store it.
Why is the PNG much larger?
PNG uses general lossless compression, while WebP may use more space-efficient lossy coding.
Does it convert animated WebP?
No. This tool is for still images and does not preserve animation.
Is processing private?
Yes. Files are decoded and encoded on your device and are not uploaded by the application.

conversions.title: PNG to WebP Converter – Free Web Image Tool | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert PNG images to WebP in your browser for modern web delivery. Batch processing, quality control, and no server uploads.
conversions.intro: Convert PNG assets to WebP when you want to reduce web image weight while retaining modern browser support. Process a batch locally and compare the results before publishing.
conversions.fromBody: PNG stores exact pixels with lossless compression and supports alpha transparency. It excels at flat-color graphics, but complex screenshots and photographic images may consume more bandwidth than necessary.
conversions.toBody: WebP offers modern lossy and lossless image coding, including alpha transparency. It is widely supported in current browsers and is frequently used to optimize site assets.
when: You are optimizing PNG assets for a modern website.
A transparent image is too large and your target supports WebP.
You want adjustable quality for screenshots or mixed-content graphics.
conversions.note: This converter exposes a quality control for WebP. At lower settings, fine text and hard edges may show artifacts; inspect important UI graphics at their actual display size.
faqs: Does WebP keep transparency?
The WebP format supports alpha transparency, and the converter retains decoded alpha data.
Will every PNG become smaller?
No. Simple, already optimized PNG graphics can be competitive; always compare actual file sizes.
What quality should I use?
Start near the default and inspect the result. Text-heavy graphics often need a higher setting than photographs.
Are dimensions changed?
No. The tool converts the format without resizing the pixel dimensions.

conversions.title: AVIF to JPG Converter – Free & Private | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert AVIF images to widely supported JPG files in your browser. Private local processing with batch conversion and quality control.
conversions.intro: Make modern AVIF images easier to open and share by converting them to JPG. Choose output quality, process several files, and keep every image on your device.
conversions.fromBody: AVIF is a modern image format based on AV1 technology. It can deliver excellent compression and supports features such as transparency, but older apps and operating systems may not decode it.
conversions.toBody: JPG is an established lossy format with exceptional software compatibility. It is straightforward to share and upload, especially for photographs without transparency.
when: An older editor or viewer cannot open AVIF.
A form or publishing system only accepts JPG.
You need a simple, widely shareable photo file.
conversions.note: JPG cannot retain AVIF transparency or HDR characteristics. Transparent areas are flattened, and output uses standard JPG encoding.
faqs: Can JPG preserve AVIF transparency?
No. JPG has no alpha channel, so transparent pixels are flattened onto white.
Will HDR be preserved?
No. This utility produces a standard JPG and is not an HDR color-management workflow.
Why convert AVIF to JPG?
Compatibility is the main reason: JPG opens in more older applications and upload systems.
Does the app upload AVIF files?
No. The codecs run locally in a browser worker.

conversions.title: AVIF to PNG Converter – Free Lossless Output | Convert Image
conversions.description: Convert AVIF files to lossless PNG images locally in your browser. Retain transparency without uploading your files.
conversions.intro: Convert AVIF images to lossless PNG for editing, transparent graphics, or compatibility with software that cannot read AVIF. Processing stays inside your browser.
conversions.fromBody: AVIF is a high-efficiency image format derived from AV1. It supports transparency and advanced color features while often producing small files, but decoding support varies in older tools.
conversions.toBody: PNG is a broadly supported, lossless raster format. It handles alpha transparency reliably and is well suited to graphics and intermediate editing files.
when: You need to edit an AVIF in software that supports PNG.
Transparency must remain available in the output.
A document or publishing workflow requires a lossless PNG file.
conversions.note: PNG is likely to be much larger than AVIF and does not preserve every advanced AVIF color or HDR characteristic. It preserves the pixels produced by the browser-side decoder.
faqs: Is the PNG output lossless?
PNG encoding is lossless for the decoded pixels, although the AVIF source may have used lossy compression.
Does transparency survive?
Yes, when transparency is present in the decoded source.
Why did the file size increase?
PNG trades compression efficiency for lossless, widely compatible storage.
Can I convert more than one AVIF?
Yes. The batch queue supports up to 20 files, each no larger than 50 MB.
